title: HB2293 (2017-2018 Regular): Restricting firearms and dangerous weapons in early learning facilities.

provenance.fetched_by: Open States public data converted to LegiScan layout (gun-policy Stage 5, Washington); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Washington Legislature text (Introduced, https://lawfilesext.leg.wa.gov/Biennium/2017-18/Htm/Bills/House%20Bills/2293.htm, downloaded directly)
provenance.note: Introduced version. Sec. 1 also covers air guns, stun guns and other dangerous weapons, requires 'GUN-FREE ZONE' signs; Sec. 2(3) lets the department deny or revoke a child care license for violations; Sec. 3 requires rules.

operative_text:
NEW SECTION Sec. 1 (new RCW section, chapter 9.41): (1) It is unlawful for a person to carry onto, or to possess on, licensed child care center premises, child care center-provided transportation, or areas of facilities while being used exclusively by a child care center: (a) Any firearm;
NEW SECTION Sec. 1 (new RCW section, chapter 9.41): (2) A person who violates subsection (1) of this section is guilty of a gross misdemeanor. If a person is convicted of a violation of subsection (1)(a) of this section, the person shall have his or her concealed pistol license, if any, revoked for a period of three years.
NEW SECTION Sec. 1 (new RCW section, chapter 9.41): (3) Subsection (1) of this section does not apply to: (a) Family day care provider homes as defined in RCW 43.216.010; (b) Any person at least eighteen years of age legally in possession of a firearm or dangerous weapon that is secured within an attended vehicle or concealed from view within a locked unattended vehicle while conducting legitimate business at the child care center; or (c) Any law enforcement officer of a federal, state, or local government agency.
NEW SECTION Sec. 2 (new RCW section, chapter 43.216): (2)(a) A family day care provider must store any firearm, ammunition, or other dangerous weapon as described in RCW 9.41.250 in a secure area when children are present on the premises. (b) The secure area must be inaccessible to children and must consist of a locked gun safe or a locked room. If stored in a locked room, each firearm must be stored unloaded and with a trigger lock or other disabling feature.
